description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'Single parents' map layer in the Demographics
section.

Single-parent families as a share of families for every mesh block in the suburb, percent 0-100. Near-empty blocks are left out. The
suburb figure is ``/demographics/single-parents``. Values only; polygons
come from ``/shapes/mesh-blocks``.
